workflow_title: First Release Hardening And Cloudflare Launch Workflow
workflow_summary: Take the already-implemented underwater math facts app through release hardening, workflow alignment, Cloudflare Pages preparation, and final verification for the first public launch.

roles.master-developer: Own workflow orchestration, reconcile repo reality with the old broader scaffold, and dispatch one bounded release-hardening task at a time.
roles.developer: Implement only the active hardening or deployment-prep slice and leave clear release-oriented notes.
roles.tester: Validate only the active slice and record concrete release risks, pass criteria, or blockers.
roles.researcher: Answer bounded Cloudflare or release-process blockers without drifting into implementation.

phases.name: Audit And Workflow Alignment
phases.goal: Reconcile the planning artifacts and workflow state with the code that is already implemented so release work starts from the real current baseline.
scope: Audit the implemented app against roadmap, spec, and the older broad workflow.
Update stale workflow notes or release-facing docs so they reflect repo reality.
Identify the highest-priority remaining release gaps.
deliverables: Clean starting baseline for the remaining hardening phases
exit_criteria: The docs no longer imply that setup, gameplay, and stats are unimplemented.
The next hardening targets are explicit and grounded in the current app.
A downstream agent can continue release work without re-auditing the whole repo.

agent_briefs.master-developer: Treat this phase as a reality-alignment pass, not a feature pass.
agent_briefs.developer: Do not add new product scope. Focus on correcting stale assumptions and making the next release tasks explicit.
agent_briefs.tester: Validate that the updated docs and notes match the observable behavior of the current app.

phases.name: Gameplay And Usability Hardening
phases.goal: Address the highest-priority fairness, distractor, responsiveness, and interaction issues in the current playable build.
scope: Tune distractor generation and survival pacing.
Polish keyboard, touch, and reduced-motion behavior where needed.
Improve responsive behavior for the current game and stats screens.
deliverables: Focused gameplay or UI polish changes
Documented remaining known limitations if any tuning is intentionally deferred
exit_criteria: The biggest currently-known playability gaps are addressed.
The app remains buildable and testable after tuning.
The first-release experience feels coherent on desktop and touch-sized layouts.
next_phase_inputs: Release candidate UI and gameplay behavior
Known limitations list if any issues remain intentionally deferred

agent_briefs.master-developer: Keep this phase tightly scoped to release-critical polish rather than backlog features.
agent_briefs.developer: Do not start accounts, teachers, or new content. Fix the highest-signal usability issues only.
agent_briefs.tester: Focus on whether the gameplay loop now feels fair, stable, and usable rather than on stylistic opinions.

phases.name: Cloudflare Pages Prep
phases.goal: Make the repo and docs ready for GitHub-connected Cloudflare Pages previews and production attachment on mathfacts.thecaseyb.com.
scope: Add or improve repo documentation for install, dev, build, and deploy.
Document the Cloudflare Pages preview and custom-domain flow.
Ensure there are no hidden local-only assumptions blocking deployment.
deliverables: Any minimal repo config changes needed for clean deployment
exit_criteria: A maintainer can follow the repo docs to build and prepare the app for Cloudflare Pages.
The preview-deploy and custom-domain flow is documented for mathfacts.thecaseyb.com.
The repo does not rely on undocumented local setup tricks.

agent_briefs.master-developer: Keep this phase pragmatic and documentation-oriented unless a tiny repo change is clearly required.
agent_briefs.developer: Focus on making deployment repeatable and understandable, not on inventing infrastructure that the app does not need.
agent_briefs.tester: Validate the docs against the real repo commands and flag any missing steps.

phases.name: Release Verification And Signoff
phases.goal: Run the final release checks, summarize known limitations, and produce a clear signoff checklist for the first public launch.
scope: Manually verify the core app flows against the release candidate.
Document the known limitations and launch checklist.
exit_criteria: The release candidate has a clear pass or blocker summary.
The launch checklist is concrete enough to use during Cloudflare Pages setup.
Known limitations are documented instead of implied.
next_phase_inputs: Clear blockers if the app is not ready

agent_briefs.master-developer: This phase is about signoff quality, not additional feature work.
agent_briefs.developer: Record release readiness clearly and keep any final edits minimal.
agent_briefs.tester: Treat this as a release gate and enumerate concrete blockers if the app is not yet ready.
